# EverySpaces — Bangalore Home Interiors

EverySpaces is a Bangalore-focused interior design company for modular kitchens, wardrobes, room makeovers, and full-home execution. We combine practical space planning, detailed BOQs, and project coordination for apartments, villas, and independent homes.

## Services

- Modular kitchen design
- Wardrobes and storage
- Living room, bedroom, kids room, and home office interiors
- 2BHK, 3BHK, villa, and complete home packages
- False ceilings, TV units, pooja rooms, and balconies

## Service areas

We serve Bangalore, including Whitefield, Indiranagar, Koramangala, HSR Layout, Sarjapur Road, Electronic City, Bellandur, Hebbal, Jayanagar, and nearby localities. See all locations: https://www.everyspaces.com/bangalore
